email.staffInvite.subject: Your HandyHub staff account
email.staffInvite.body:
You have been invited to the HandyHub staff app.

Set your password with this link. It works once and expires in {hours} hours:
{url}

If you did not expect this email, you can ignore it.
email.staffReset.subject: Reset your HandyHub staff password
email.staffReset.body:
Someone asked to reset the password of your HandyHub staff account.

Choose a new password with this link. It works once and expires in {hours} hours:
{url}

If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email; your password stays the same.
signIn.heading: Staff sign-in
forgot.heading: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the email of your staff account. If it belongs to an account, we send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If that email belongs to a staff account, a reset link is on its way. The link works once.
setPassword.hint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence works well.
setPassword.done: Your password is saved. Sign in with your new password.
setPassword.invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask the owner for a new invite, or request a new reset link.
error.CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID: Your session needs refreshing. Reload the page and try again.
error.NOT_CONFIGURED: This is not set up yet. Ask the owner.
mfa.heading: Enter your authenticator code
mfa.intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for HandyHub.
security.heading: Sign-in security
security.recommended: An authenticator app is recommended for your account. It keeps your account safe even if your password is guessed.
security.enrolled: Your authenticator app is set up.
security.notEnrolled: No authenticator app is set up.
security.secretIntro: Add this key to your authenticator app (for example by choosing "Enter a setup key"), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
security.recoveryIntro: Keep these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
security.reauthIntro: Enter your password again to continue.
shell.notBuilt: This screen is not available yet.
shell.notBuiltBody: It will be added in a later release.
shell.notAllowed: This screen is not part of your role.
shell.noNavigation: Your account has no screens yet. Ask the owner to check your role.
language.label: Language
language.saveFailed: The language could not be saved. Try again.
offline.title: You are offline.
offline.body: Screens show what was last loaded. Nothing is sent until you are back online.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this while you were editing.
conflict.body: Nothing was saved. Compare the current values with yours, then review and redo your change.

enum.healthNote.migrations_unreadable: The applied migrations could not be compared with this version of the code.
enum.healthNote.provider_unknown: This process was not given its provider settings, so their state is unknown.
enum.healthNote.fake_provider: A test stand-in is used instead of the real provider (local and CI only).

system.unavailableBody: Nothing on this screen is known to be healthy until it loads.
system.health.intro: Read from what the system records. Anything it cannot observe shows as unknown or NOT CONFIGURED, never as OK.
system.health.loadFailed: System health could not be loaded.
system.health.testDestinationCounts: {emails, plural, one {# email address} other {# email addresses}}, {phones, plural, one {# phone number} other {# phone numbers}}
system.health.listLimit: Each list below shows the newest 20.
system.config.intro: Every decided value is active, versioned configuration citing its decision. A missing fact shows as NOT CONFIGURED and is never invented. This view is read-only.
system.config.loadFailed: The configuration could not be loaded.
system.config.variablesIntro: Set by the owner in Render. Only whether each one is set is shown; values are never shown.
system.config.variablesUnknown: This process was not given its environment, so which settings are set is unknown.
request.actionDone: Done. The request has moved on.
request.actionUnavailable: Not available for this request now, or not part of your role.
request.askHint: This records that the customer needs to answer questions. Writing and publishing the questions comes with the questions feature; no message is sent to the customer now.
request.customerPreference: Customer's stated preference: {preference}. Staff confirm the approach.
request.customerReasonHint: Finish the sentence "We're unable to take on this project because …". Do not name other companies.
request.notAFitHint: If work was accepted, an appointment exists or money was received, this goes to the Owner for cancellation and financial review instead of closing.
request.notesHint: Staff only. Never shown to the customer and kept apart from customer messages.
request.onlineHint: The estimate is written next; nothing is sent to the customer now.
request.originalHint: Exactly as the customer sent it. It cannot be edited.
request.qualificationHint: Staff check each point; AI classification is off. Both estimating routes need every point answered.
request.refused: This was not done. What is needed:
request.routedToOwner: Sent to the Owner for cancellation and financial review. Nothing was closed.
request.spamHint: The quiet spam controls flagged this request. Review it like any other; nothing was discarded.
request.visitExplanationHint: Why a site visit is needed, in English.
request.visitHint: No visit is booked and no message is sent now; the visit windows are offered next.
request.workPackagesHint: One project; each service becomes its own work package.
requests.loadFailed: The requests could not be loaded. Try again.
enum.requestNextStep.qualify_and_choose: Qualify the request and choose an action
enum.requestDecision.not_a_fit_owner_rev: Not a Fit, sent to the Owner for financial review
enum.coverageResult.out_of_coverage: Outside the service area; staff decide
enum.requestRefusal.INVALID_TRANSITION: This action is not possible from the request's current status.
enum.requestRefusal.PROJECT_NOT_OPEN: The project is not open (for example it waits for the Owner's review).
enum.requestRefusal.REASON_REQUIRED: A written reason or explanation is required.
enum.requestRefusal.OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRE: Accepted work, an appointment or money exists; this goes to the Owner.
enum.requestRefusal.FACTS_MISSING: The server could not check everything it needs. Try again.
enum.requestRefusal.ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED: This action cannot be taken by staff.
enum.queueReason.not_a_fit_with_obligati: Not a Fit with accepted work, an appointment or money received

enum.customerTimeline.candidate_dismisse: Possible duplicate reviewed: not the same customer
customers.searchHint: Name, exact email, phone or project reference.
customers.loadFailed: The customers could not be loaded. Try again.
customers.possibleDuplicates: {count, plural, one {# possible duplicate} other {# possible duplicates}}
customer.heading: Customer {name}
customer.notAvailable: Not available yet: these records are added in a later release.
customer.reasonHint: Required. Kept with the change; staff only.
customer.stale: Someone changed this record meanwhile. Nothing was saved; the current record is shown.
customer.invalid: Check the highlighted values and try again.
customer.merged: This record was merged into another one and is no longer edited.
customer.permissionsHint: A phone number is never permission to text. Marketing is a separate permission.
customer.consentSameDestination: Recorded for the same email or number outside this contact.
customer.editContactHint: A changed email or phone is unverified until the customer verifies it.
customer.textNeedsOptIn: Text as the preferred channel needs a current SMS opt-in for this number.
customer.recordOptOutHint: Record what the customer asked for. Staff never record an opt-in for the customer.
customer.optOutReasonHint: Required: how and when the customer asked.
customer.candidatesHint: Suggestions only: a shared email, phone or address is never proof that two records are the same person. Nothing is merged or linked automatically.
customer.dismissHint: Required: why these are different customers. Nothing is changed on either record.
customer.notesHint: Staff only. Notes are never shown to the customer and are kept apart from customer messages.
customer.noteHint: Never write passwords, access codes or card numbers in a note.
customer.noteMasked: Restricted note: not shown to your role.
customer.noteSensitive: This looks like a card number. Card numbers never go in a note.
customer.historyTruncated: Only the newest entries are shown.
enum.queueReason.message_needs_linking: An inbound email or text could not be matched to exactly one project: link it, never by name alone
enum.queueReason.customer_replied: The customer sent an email or text on this project
enum.matchRule.reply_token: Matched by the project's reply address
enum.matchRule.latest_conversation: Matched to the latest open conversation
enum.needsLinkingReason.no_match: No verified contact or reference matches
enum.needsLinkingReason.no_open_project: The customer has no open project
enum.needsLinkingReason.sender_not_on_pr: The sender is not a contact of the referenced project
enum.needsLinkingReason.returned_by_staf: Returned to Needs Linking by staff
enum.bodyState.html_converted: HTML-only email: shown as plain text
enum.bodyState.not_retrieved: The email text was not retrieved: email is not configured
enum.bodyState.retrieval_failed: The email text could not be retrieved
inbox.loadFailed: The inbox could not be loaded. Try again.
inbox.notConfiguredSms: Texts are not received until the owner sets BIRD_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Nothing is shown as received.
inbox.notConfiguredEmail: Email is not received until the owner sets RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Nothing is shown as received.
inbox.bodiesNotConfigured: Email text cannot be read until email (Resend) is configured; messages arrive without their text.
inbox.bodiesFake: Test server: email text comes only from synthetic test messages.
inbox.replyTokensNotConfigured: Set INBOUND_EMAIL_ADDRESS so project emails carry their reply address; until then replies match by thread and verified email only.
inbox.unsupported: {count, plural, one {# message arrived on an unsupported channel} other {# messages arrived on unsupported channels}}
inbox.unsupportedHint: The inbox handles texts and email only; check those messages in the provider's dashboard.
inbox.needsLinkingIntro: Private to the Owner and Office. These messages are attached to no customer until you link them.
inbox.notFound: No conversation or inbound message has this ID, or it is outside your access. A failed notification is retried from the action queue.
inbox.truncated: Long message: only the beginning is kept.
inbox.subject: Subject: {subject}
inbox.attachmentsNotImported: {count, plural, one {# attachment was not imported; open it in the provider's dashboard.} other {# attachments were not imported; open them in the provider's dashboard.}}
inbox.customerMessagesIntro: Email and texts exactly as received. Replies from the project arrive in a later release.
inbox.noNotifications: No notifications recorded for this project.
inbox.internalIntro: Staff only. Internal messages never reach the customer and never change scope or price.
inbox.internalHint: Never write passwords, access codes or card numbers in a message.
inbox.originalIntro: Kept exactly as received; linking never changes it.
inbox.linkIntro: Link only when you are sure who sent it. A shared email or phone or a name is never proof; the correction and your reason are recorded.
inbox.noCandidates: No project has a contact with this address.
inbox.stale: This message changed meanwhile. It was reloaded; check it and try again.
inbox.cardNumber: This looks like a card number. Remove it; card numbers are never written in messages.
inbox.alreadyOnProject: The message is already on that project.
inbox.invalid: Check the reference and the reason.
inbox.linkNeeds: Enter a project reference and a reason.
